feed.title: NPR Topics: News
feed.subtitle: Breaking news, top national and world stories, politics, business and culture from NPR. Catch up on demand with NPR News Now, Up First and Consider This.

entry.title: S&P 500 sinks 3.7% and the Nasdaq composite goes negative for the year
entry.summary: AI stocks have hefty market values and have a much bigger impact on the market's direction. They were responsible for Wall Street's big gains this year and are now behind the big slide for the market.

entry.title: The latest from Trump's press conference
entry.summary: President Trump gave a wide-ranging press conference following his historic trip to Asia where he met with Chinese President Xi and Russian President Putin.

entry.title: Rising seas have forced this Quinault village to relocate
entry.summary: The Quinault Indian Nation has moved its largest village away from rising seas and tsunamis

entry.title: Trump's impact on an Ohio steel plant
entry.summary: The giant steel plant in Middletown, Ohio planned to switch away from using coke, a refined form of coal. The switch would have cut hazardous air pollution -- and greenhouse gas emissions. But that plan has changed under President Trump

entry.title: MLK's handwritten draft of iconic speech on display for the first time
entry.summary: The only known handwritten draft of The Reverend Martin Luther King Jr.'s 'I Have a Dream' speech is on display in his hometown. The iconic phrase, however, never made it on the page.

entry.title: A second judge blocks Trump's arch, saying it's unlikely to succeed in court
entry.summary: A federal judge in Virginia said she will issue a preliminary injunction against Trump's arch, going a step further than the D.C. federal judge who temporarily blocked construction earlier this week.

entry.title: Trump initially accepted the midterm results, but most GOP voters doubt they were fair
entry.summary: Less than half of Republicans nationwide considered the midterm elections "free and fair," according to new polling.

entry.title: How Orchestra Noir turned classical music into a cultural movement
entry.summary: Orchestra Noir is back on tour, selling out stages across the country and proving classical music can be anything you want it to be.

entry.title: Trump touts meeting with Xi and Putin but offers little results
entry.summary: At a White House press conference Friday, Trump offered little in actual results of the meetings, beyond a joint statement on unity over some issues.

entry.title: Texas execution took over an hour as staff struggled to find vein; Reinaldo Dennes moaned about pain
entry.summary: The same day Dennes was given lethal injection, Florida carried out a record-breaking 20th execution of the year.
